clips.title: The story
paras: Witchwing harpies menace the Dry Hills, where greener slopes rise above the Barrens.

The Dry Hills grow greener than the dry plains below, on the Barrens' northwestern edge beneath the Stonetalon Mountains. Travelers find little safety among the bluffs. Serena Bloodfeather leads the Witchwing harpies from their roosts along the crags. Their raiding parties swoop down on supply caravans along the northern Gold Road. Abandoned orcish fortifications and derelict siege engines lie rotting in the brush.

Witchwing harpies strike out from the hills to bleed trade routes and harass nearby settlements, so the Horde keeps a standing bounty on their feathers. In the rocky ravines, their nests and roosts are heavily defended. Hecklefang hyenas prowl there, and fierce Sunscale raptors hunt across the highlands.
